title.tagline: pixiv finds the art · X searches your terms and follows the artists pixiv found

tags.heading: Discovery — pixiv tags
tags.hint: Every artwork carrying one of these tags is pulled. Matching is exact: 申鶴 and 申鶴(原神) are different tags, and fullwidth（）will not match.

terms.heading: X search & match terms
terms.hint: Each term is searched on X (images only) and also filters the timelines of artists found on pixiv. Searching is the traffic X polices hardest — a few precise terms beat many loose ones, and use a throwaway account.

bookmarks.label: Minimum bookmarks
bookmarks.note: Skip pixiv artworks saved by fewer people than this. 0 downloads everything.
bookmarks.pixivOff: pixiv is off for this character, so this has no effect.

help.what: On pixiv, “bookmarks” is how many people saved an artwork — a rough measure of how popular it is.
help.rule: Artworks with fewer bookmarks than this number are not downloaded. 0 downloads everything.
help.raise: Raising it only affects artworks found from now on. Nothing you already have is removed.
help.lower: Lowering it gives the skipped artworks another chance: the next crawl checks them again.
help.x: X has no bookmarks, so this setting never affects X.

preview.heading: Preview
preview.lead: {tag} · newest first · confirm this is the right character

suggestions.heading: Suggested tags
suggestions.lead: Names and forms from Danbooru and Wikidata, in the languages they know — plus tags that co-occur on pixiv once it's signed in.
suggestions.addXLabel: Add {text} as an X search term
suggestions.risky: short — loose as an X term
suggestions.empty: type a name to see suggestions
suggestions.nothing: no names found for this character
suggestions.refresh: Suggestions refresh after every crawl from the tags observed on this character's posts.

errors.name: a display name is what the gallery shows
errors.noTags: at least one pixiv tag: without it there is no discovery source (or untick pixiv)
errors.allFullwidth: every tag uses fullwidth（）— none will match
errors.noSource: tick at least one source — pixiv, X, or both
errors.noTerms: X needs at least one term when pixiv is off — the terms are what X searches for

sources.off: off — this source is skipped for this character

crawl.heading: Crawl target
crawl.hint: Each run collects the next batch of new posts. Posts already crawled, marked, or rejected by the recognition model are skipped and never count toward the target.

recognition.label: Recognition filter
recognition.on: skip photos, cosplay, 3D and screenshots — keep illustrations and anime screencaps

cycle.heading: Run cycle
cycle.note: Images per run vary — one post can hold several pages.

run.line: This run: next {n} new posts of {total} matching · {time}

gender.label: Gender filter

hint.any: off — keep every character, any gender
hint.femaleFull: only girls in the picture — boys, mixed art and images with nobody are thrown away
hint.femalePartial: girls, with fewer boys allowed — 2 girls + 1 boy stays, 1 girl + 1 boy does not
hint.maleFull: only boys in the picture — girls, mixed art and images with nobody are thrown away
hint.malePartial: boys, with fewer girls allowed — 2 boys + 1 girl stays, 1 boy + 1 girl does not

gender.cost: tags every image of this character (~0.6 s each; a 467 MB model downloads on first use)
